answer.says: Shri Hegde, the day is beginning. I see you are already awake. I trust the night was restful? I must attend to my reading of the papers, but I wished to ensure you have settled into the second bedroom as the file dictates. Please, do not hesitate to call if you require anything before I step out.
answer.thought: The presence of the Joint Secretary in my own bungalow is a friction I must manage with courtesy. He is a particular person, subordinate to the ethical fabric of the state, yet here he occupies the space of my private life. I must maintain the distance of the master of the house while acknowledging the bureaucratic reality that has placed us together.
